sources.name: Witkowski et al. Ultrafast Correlation Energy Estimator article
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated in the article
sources.acquisition: Retrieve the open-access article and its Supporting Information through DOI 10.1021/acs.jpca.5c04423. The values this experiment uses were transcribed from main-text Tables 2-4 and SI Tables S1, S2, S4, S5 into inputs.json, whose SHA-256 fingerprint is recorded in the metrics provenance.
sources.exclusion_reason: The publisher PDF and SI files are not redistributed and no local copy was retained after transcription, so no file checksum is recorded here; the frozen numerical transcription in inputs.json is the fingerprinted input. The article's tables are stable published values at a stable DOI.
